scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run validate
scripts.lint: oxfmt --check scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .github/workflows && oxlint --deny-warnings scripts
scripts.fix: oxlint --fix scripts && oxfmt --write scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .github/workflows
